title: Get started with Asset Store

author: Unity
description:
See how the Unity Asset Store can speed up game development in Unity 6. In this video, we use free assets including character controllers, environments, gameplay systems, audio, VFX, tools, and templates to build a simple, playable scene with collectibles and interactive gameplay.

Assets used: 
🔗 Character Controller: https://on.unity.com/4wb8k2S
🔗 Polygon Starter Pack: https://on.unity.com/4gHYOzj
🔗 Ten Powerups: https://on.unity.com/4vx7I6A
🔗 Magic Particle Effects: https://on.unity.com/4ylm5h3
🔗 Heart Health System: https://on.unity.com/4hhvXSA
🔗 Water Toon Shader: https://on.unity.com/4gIk1cA
🔗 Casual Game SFX: https://on.unity.com/4hbIC9K
🔗 Kart Racing Music: https://on.unity.com/4vxJSr8

Link to the bundle:
🔗 https://on.unity.com/quick_start_bundle26

[00:00] Intro
[00:51] Downloading and Installing player character and environmental assets
[02:23] Adding character controller
[02:58] Adding and setting up star collectable
[04:29] Creating simple UI for collecting stars
